summary: Changed the cursor type in Yarn. Route chosen: sidebar → Brand Kit → Screen Clips (the brand-wide default), because the request was phrased generally ("the cursor type") rather than about a specific project/recording — so the new value applies to all future screen clips using the Default Brand. I opened the Cursor Style combobox (options: Arrow-first / Pointer-first / Original), picked "Arrow-first" (an unspecified value, so I chose a different one from the previous "Pointer-first"), then clicked "Save Changes". The page now shows Cursor Style = Arrow-first with the Save Changes / Cancel pair gone, confirming the change persisted. Note the per-project override (Project actions ⋯ → Screen Clip Settings…) is a separate store and was left untouched.
